# defectdojo_test_types (Data Source)

Use this data source to list DefectDojo's test types: the kinds of tests, among them one per scanner DefectDojo can import, such as `Trivy Scan`. For example, check that a scan type exists before a pipeline imports it:

```terraform
data "defectdojo_test_types" "all" {}

check "trivy" {
  assert {
    condition     = contains(data.defectdojo_test_types.all.names, "Trivy Scan")
    error_message = "DefectDojo has no Trivy Scan test type."
  }
}
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_test_types" "all" {}

# Check that DefectDojo knows a scan type before a pipeline imports it.
check "trivy" {
  assert {
    condition     = contains(data.defectdojo_test_types.all.names, "Trivy Scan")
    error_message = "DefectDojo has no Trivy Scan test type."
  }
}

data "defectdojo_test_types" "zap" {
  name = "ZAP Scan"
}

output "zap_test_type_id" {
  value = one(data.defectdojo_test_types.zap.test_types[*].id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Lists only the test type with exactly this name, compared case-sensitively. Without it, all test types are listed. An unknown name gives empty lists, not an error.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) The names of the test types, in the order of `test_types`.
- `test_types` (Attributes List) The test types, ordered by name, case-sensitively, as Terraform's `sort()` does: names starting with a lowercase letter come last. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--test_types))

<a id="nestedatt--test_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `test_types`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the test type is offered for new tests.
- `dynamic_tool` (Boolean) Whether the test type is a dynamic analysis tool.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the test type.
- `name` (String) The name of the test type, such as `Trivy Scan`.
- `static_tool` (Boolean) Whether the test type is a static analysis tool.
